Important interpretation: `initial_loss_mean` is an MSE-style squared loss, while `initial_diff_rms_mean` is the RMS amplitude of `model - solver`. Therefore an MSE ratio near `0.01` corresponds to an RMS ratio near `0.10`, not a one-percent output-amplitude error.
